subject: Wrap-up: simplify next steps for inference pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Shah <samira@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Wrap-up: simplify next steps for inference pilot

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our 30‑minute discovery so we’re aligned and to keep momentum small and simple: 

- Goal: run a 6‑week inference pilot to validate latency and cost on your top 3 internal prompts (clinical summarization, triage routing, and patient messaging).
- What Redwood will deliver: a dedicated pilot environment, a one‑page performance baseline after week 1, and an ops runbook for handoff.
- What Aurelia will provide: 3 representative prompt sets + one engineering contact for infra access.
- Success criteria: median generation latency < 250ms, cost per 1k tokens under the agreed target, and qualitative acceptability from the clinical team.

Next steps I suggested on the call (short):
1) I’ll send the pilot scope & SLA draft (attached).
2) You share the prompt sets and point-of-contact by EOD next Tuesday (Apr 13).
3) We start the pilot the following Monday if prompts and access are available.

If that timeline doesn’t work, tell me what does — happy to compress or push. If you want, we can also scope a smaller 2‑week spike first.

Attachments: pilot-scope.pdf (pilot scope + calendar of milestones), redwood-sla-draft.docx
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2B3cPilotScope

Thanks — I’ll follow up in a week if I don’t hear back.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks, Karthik — appreciate the clear summary. Quick notes from our side:

- The goals look right.
- I’m coordinating with our head of clinical ops (out on travel this week) who needs to sign off on the prompt sets; I should have an update by end of week.
- Timeline: we may not be able to fully commit to a Monday start because of a compliance review on our side — can you give us a two‑week window instead?

Also can you confirm whether Redwood needs production data for the first baseline, or can we run against a synthetic subset?

Best,
Samira

samira@aureliahealth.com
